title: Vetted crypto backends
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.2 Key Management.

statements.label: Vetted crypto backends
statements.requirement: Cryptography SHALL use platform or vetted libraries: JCA/BouncyCastle or Android Keystore for Kotlin JVM/Android, RustCrypto (p256, rsa, sha2) or ring/aws-lc-rs for Rust. Signature verification SHALL be constant-time where the backend allows. The libraries SHALL NOT contain their own implementations of cryptographic primitives.
